author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Today's Stock Market Has Apple, Amazon Price Hikes | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes moved squarely higher in today's stock market action led by the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite. Large-cap tech stocks Apple ( AAPL ) and Amazon.com ( AMZN ) received favorable price-target hikes. Meanwhile, top growth stock PayPal ( PYPL ) is rebounding from its 50-day support level. (For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X
The tech-heavy Nasdaq surged 0.7% to lead the major stock indexes. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones industrial average climbed 0.4% and 0.2%, respectively.
Analyst Actions: Amazon, Apple Price Increases FANG stock Amazon.com moved up 1.5% after Stifel Nicolaus raised its price target on the e-commerce giant from 2,020 to 2,525. The update price target is about 28% greater than Wednesday's closing price. The stock added to its three-day win streak and is rising from its 50-day line after support on Monday.
Apple gained over 2% on JPMorgan's overweight rating with a 272 price target. Analyst Samik Chatterjee is upbeat about the company's "faster-than-expected transformation to a services business." Apple stock is just 2% off its highs, about 16% from a flat base's 194.30 buy point.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Payment processor PayPal ( PYPL ) was initiated with an outperform rating and a 112 price target at BMO Capital. Shares rose 0.5% but remain below the recent flat base 's 92.45 buy point. Still, the stock is holding above its 50-day support level.
On the downside, Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) fell 1.5% after Northland Securities cut its rating from outperform to market perform. The analyst commented, "We believe that AMD sentiment is currently in between optimistic and euphoric."
IBD 50 Stocks: Cybersecurity Stocks Lead Among the top growth stocks , cybersecurity stock CyberArk Software ( CYBR ) advanced 5% after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock from equal weight to overweight with a raised 92 price target. The stock leader is nearing a new high after finding support near the 50-day line.
Meanwhile, Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) moved up nearly 1%. Shares are on the cusp of again being extended beyond the 5% buy range of a flat base's 219.48 entry.
On the downside, Chinese stock Momo ( MOMO ) dropped 2%, as it trades above its 50-day line. A potential breakout above a deep cup with handle 's 47.85 buy point triggered the 7%-8% loss-cutting sell rule . A potential flaw is the stock's lagging relative strength line . A new handle is forming that shows a 49.48 entry.
